port.name: lazygit
port.description: Living Code for lazygit. Repository-owned theme files, installation instructions and four color flavors.

guide.installation:
lazygit accepts a comma-separated list of config files, so the theme sits next to your own config without editing it. `lazygit --print-config-dir` finds the right folder on every OS:

```sh
flavor=night
dir="$(lazygit --print-config-dir)"
mkdir -p "$dir" && touch "$dir/config.yml"
curl -fsSL --create-dirs -o "$dir/living-code-$flavor.yml" "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/living-code-theme/lazygit/main/living-code-$flavor.yml"
export LG_CONFIG_FILE="$dir/config.yml,$dir/living-code-$flavor.yml"
```

Put the `export` line in your shell profile to keep it. Or merge the downloaded `theme:` block into `config.yml` by hand.
guide.configuration: See [lazygit's documentation](https://github.com/jesseduffield/lazygit) for application settings and reload behavior. The activation instructions above identify each supported flavor; keep your other application configuration.
guide.compatibility: This port supplies theme files for lazygit, not the application itself. Install the application separately and follow the installation instructions for its supported configuration format.
